items.root_cause: Three detectors find the same class of question (does this product belong to this commodity?) and write three files nobody reads: coverage-gaps.json, semantic-findings.json, aisle-test.json. The resolver scripts exist (explain-coverage-gap, apply-coverage-batch, add-known-wrong) but no lane consumes the findings and no ledger remembers a decision, so an undecided finding is re-paged whenever any member of its set changes (signature de-dup over the whole set). Measured: 0 of the 21 actionable gaps and 0 of the 3 semantic rows carry a recorded decision today, and 9 of the 21 are live wrong-product ROUTINGS (a claimer commodity holding a product that is not its food) that the page has described as 'a store dropped' for weeks.

root_fix.what: one worklist and one verdict ledger for all three detectors; the daily chain merges and decides, the weekly unattended lane applies decided rule changes through apply-coverage-batch in gated batches, and the three alert types page only NEW undecided keys under -Lane weekly
root_fix.exact_change: (1) match-worklist-lib.ps1: Read-MatchFindings returns one row per kind|commodity|store|name from coverage-gaps.json (actionable only), semantic-findings.json (coverage rows) and aisle-test.json (BLOCK rows), each with the detector's own evidence (reason, claimer, cos/score, dept). Merge-MatchWorklist keeps first_seen/last_seen, drops a key the detector no longer reports, and skips any key in match-verdicts.json. (2) resolve-match-worklist.ps1 runs in the daily chain after the three detectors (fan-out lane, marker MATCH-WORKLIST-COMPLETE scanned= decided= undecided= new=): it classifies each undecided key as release (the claimer is not the product's food), widen (no rule admits the product's own food), confirm (the claim or refusal is right: written to match-verdicts.json at once), ad-line (the name offers two or more products), or undecided; the classifier is the sidecar identity score of product-vs-target against product-vs-claimer AND a head-noun check, and it DECIDES only when both agree. It writes grocery/out/match-worklist.json and never edits a rule. (3) apply-coverage-batch.ps1 -FromWorklist <n>: takes the n oldest release/widen keys, derives the release exclude or the widened pattern, runs its existing gates (routing, gate 2b from batch 2, its revert), and records each outcome (applied, reverted with the gate's reason, ruled known-wrong through add-known-wrong.ps1) in match-verdicts.json keyed as the worklist is. (4) check-ad-cycles.ps1: the three alert blocks read match-worklist.json and page, through Send-AlertConditions -Lane weekly, only keys whose first_seen is today and that are still undecided; the body lists them with the lane's classification and no command. (5) audit-coverage-gaps.ps1 carries the worklist's first_seen into coverage-gaps.json so the daily REVIEW line says how old each gap is. (6) alert-registry.json: semantic-sweep, stores-dropped and wrong-department resolver 'digest' -> 'lane:grocery/resolve-match-worklist.ps1', in the same commit. ACCEPTANCE BAR, written before the classifier is built: over the 24 frozen labels in the evidence (21 gaps + 3 semantic rows), 0 wrong decisions among the keys the classifier decides, with coverage printed beside it (decided of 24). If the bar is not met, the lane ships DOCKET-ONLY: it decides nothing, writes every key with its evidence, and the weekly lane (an unattended agent, lane:grocery/triage-due.ps1) adjudicates from the docket.
